scope: Primary-source research for Ompra's curated catalog; documentation verified, authenticated execution not tested. Generic MCP configuration examples must be adapted to the OMP client schema.
licensingRule: A catalog link or authored integration guide does not redistribute a provider's hosted service, code, branding, or OpenAI connector. Hosted-service access remains subject to the provider's account, plan, permission, and service terms. An MIT wrapper must never imply the connected SaaS service is MIT licensed.

integrations.name: Google Workspace MCP
integrations.availability: Maintained open-source bridge; recommended practical route for ordinary Google accounts, with manual OAuth setup.
integrations.packageVersionObserved: 2.1.0 on upstream main; pin a release or immutable revision before distribution.
integrations.auth: Google OAuth using the user's own Google Cloud OAuth client. Enable only requested Google APIs and permissions; interactive first-use consent, then token refresh.
prerequisites: Google Cloud project with requested APIs enabled
User-owned OAuth client and local callback
Python and uv available separately; internet
features: Drive search, read, create, share, Office import
limitations: Community publisher, not Google or OpenAI
No included OAuth credentials or automatic API enablement
Google Chat additionally requires a Workspace account and Chat app setup
API quotas and Google account permissions apply
Local credential storage must be redirected into an Ompra portable profile before claiming portability

integrations.name: Google Workspace official MCP (Developer Preview)
integrations.availability: Official hosted developer preview; advanced setup, not a universally available one-click connector.
integrations.auth: Google OAuth 2.0 with user-owned OAuth client credentials; per-product scopes.
prerequisites: Google Workspace Developer Preview Program acceptance
Requested standard and MCP APIs enabled
Workspace administrator approval where policies require it
features: Gmail search, read, drafts and labels
limitations: Preview eligibility and service availability
Do not infer email-send support from draft tools
No local executable is required by native HTTP clients; gcloud is a setup aid
Google Cloud quotas and enterprise policies apply

integrations.name: Notion
integrations.auth: OAuth authorization; PKCE and refresh-token persistence/rotation required. Supports dynamic registration or Client ID Metadata Documents.
prerequisites: Workspace owner policies may restrict clients
features: Read, create and edit pages and databases
limitations: The old open-source notion-mcp-server is no longer actively maintained and is not the recommended route
Hosted MCP must not be configured with an arbitrary Notion integration bearer token
Workspace permissions still apply

integrations.name: Linear
integrations.availability: Official hosted MCP; prioritize. A read-only endpoint is available.
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or an OAuth bearer token / Linear API key in Authorization.
prerequisites: OAuth support or a scoped API key
features: Find, create and update issues, projects and comments
limitations: Use read-only endpoint or request read scope for read-only workflows
Each workspace needs a separate auth context
SSE endpoint is deprecated

integrations.name: Atlassian: Jira and Confluence
integrations.availability: Official hosted MCP; prioritize for Atlassian Cloud.
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1; API-token authentication is documented as an optional route.
prerequisites: OAuth-capable client or documented API-token setup
features: Create and update work items and pages
Additional supported products include Bitbucket, Loom and Teamwork Graph
limitations: Cloud hosted, not a generic Jira Server/Data Center connector
New integrations should use v2 rather than legacy v1/sse
Enriched search and Teamwork Graph calls can consume Rovo credits; account limits apply
App/service terms are separate from any repository documentation license

integrations.name: Stripe
integrations.availability: Official hosted MCP; prioritize with read-only/sandbox defaults.
integrations.auth: OAuth, or an Agent API key as Authorization bearer token; permissions are chosen per account/environment.
prerequisites: OAuth support or a user-owned Agent API key
features: Read and write supported customer, billing and payment API data
limitations: Financial writes need explicit user approval
Starting 2026-10-31 full-access and restricted API keys without the Agent tag are no longer accepted by MCP
Some analytics need Sigma; preview tools have separate availability
Service access is not an MIT license grant

integrations.name: Plane
integrations.availability: Official hosted MCP plus MIT self-hosted/stdio implementation; prioritize.
integrations.auth: Hosted OAuth uses read/write scopes and a chosen workspace. PAT route requires Authorization: Bearer <PAT> plus x-workspace-slug. Local stdio uses environment variables.
prerequisites: For private self-hosted instances use local stdio or own MCP host
features: Work items, comments and time logs
Pages, templates, releases and customers according to plan
limitations: Hosted service cannot reach a private Plane instance
Old npm @makeplane/plane-mcp-server is deprecated
MIT server does not make all Plane SaaS features free
No separate read-only endpoint; use tool permissions

integrations.name: Jotform
integrations.availability: Official hosted OAuth MCP; prioritize after OAuth compatibility verification.
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.0 per user; bearer API-key access is explicitly unsupported.
prerequisites: Workspace administrator can install the MCP app
limitations: Hosted service requires internet
Existing plan limits still apply
Do not claim rich embedded form-preview UI without implementing MCP App support
Primary marketing documentation contains conflicting paid-plan rate figures; do not hardcode a paid-plan rate

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.availability: Official hosted MCP, restricted registration: advanced/manual setup rather than universal one-click install.
integrations.auth: Registered Slack app with fixed app ID; OAuth user tokens. Standard confidential OAuth needs client ID/secret; PKCE documentation is available for desktop clients. No Dynamic Client Registration.
prerequisites: A Slack Marketplace-published app or an internal app
limitations: Unlisted apps cannot use the official MCP service
Search scopes include search:read.public/private/im/mpim/files/users as required
Writes require chat:write or corresponding scope; message-history scopes are separate
Native Slack service and its branding are not redistributable OSS

integrations.name: Asana
integrations.availability: Official v2 MCP is generally available; a new client must pre-register an MCP OAuth app.
integrations.auth: User OAuth with pre-registered client ID/secret, callback and workspace distribution; no Dynamic Client Registration. MCP tokens differ from API/PAT tokens.
prerequisites: Own MCP app in Asana developer console or an approved registered client
limitations: Asana Command is a separate endpoint/product requiring a Command license
Do not use deprecated v1 SSE
OAuth scope parameter should be omitted/default; user permissions govern available MCP tools
An ordinary Asana REST API PAT is not a proven MCP authentication substitute

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.availability: Official hosted CRM MCP; manual OAuth connector setup required for a new client.
integrations.auth: Create an MCP connector in HubSpot Development, supply client ID/secret and exact redirect URL; OAuth with PKCE. Scope availability follows tool set, user permissions and consent.
prerequisites: HubSpot account with Development/MCP Connectors access
features: Content and account configuration where account permissions permit
limitations: Remote CRM MCP differs from local HubSpot Developer MCP, which builds apps/CMS assets
Call get_user_details after connecting to discover available tools
Objects and write features depend on subscription/permissions; no blanket all-features claim
Some advanced marketing/revenue features need Professional/Enterprise subscriptions

integrations.name: Dropbox
integrations.availability: Official hosted open beta; automatic registration limited to trusted clients. Ompra requires own Dropbox app credentials or provider approval.
integrations.auth: Dropbox OAuth. For an unlisted MCP client, create a scoped Full Dropbox app and configure its credentials/callback; do not impersonate another approved client.
prerequisites: Trusted client or own Dropbox app
Team administrator may restrict app creation/connections
features: Shared links, file requests, revisions and recovery according to plan
limitations: DCR trusted list currently names Claude, Codex, ChatGPT and Cursor rather than Ompra
GetFileContent and inline text creation are limited to 5 MB
Paper tools currently supported only in specific approved clients; do not promise Ompra support
Recovery windows and Sign availability depend on plan

integrations.name: Microsoft 365 Work IQ (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive)
integrations.availability: Official hosted MCP; enterprise/admin and commercial setup. Keep in advanced connections rather than represent as a free Outlook/Teams one-click clone.
integrations.auth: Microsoft Entra delegated user authentication; tenant service principal/app registration and admin consent. Discovery via protected-resource metadata.
prerequisites: Microsoft 365 organization and accessible business data
Current Work IQ billing/licensing configured for the selected access path
features: Mail, meetings, files and Teams context
Schema discovery and Copilot reasoning where authorized
limitations: Personal Outlook.com account support is not verified
New projects should use consolidated Work IQ rather than obsolete per-app MCP endpoints
Official docs distinguish usage-billed Work IQ API from connector-backed licensing; prerequisites vary
Repo wrapper source has MIT license; this does not grant free Microsoft 365 service access
integrations.softwareLicense: MIT (microsoft/work-iq repository source; service terms separate)

integrations.name: Shopify Dev MCP
integrations.availability: Official local developer-documentation MCP; do not mislabel as merchant store administration.
features: Development guidance for apps and integrations
limitations: Cannot infer merchant product/order management from documentation tools
Pin a verified package version instead of latest in a curated executable package
Software license has not been independently verified from the package/repository during this research; do not copy code or assert MIT until checked

integrations.name: Shopify Storefront MCP
integrations.availability: Official commerce MCP; store-specific setup. Different from a Shopify Admin connector.
features: Buyer-side catalog/cart/checkout operations from the applicable commerce server
limitations: Requires user's merchant domain and applicable UCP discovery/profile negotiation
Customer-account operations require the separate customer-account MCP/auth flow
Not a verified general-purpose Shopify Admin MCP for creating products, managing merchant inventory or all store orders

notRecommendedOrUnverified.name: notion-mcp-server local legacy
notRecommendedOrUnverified.reason: Provider explicitly says no longer actively maintained; prefer official hosted Notion OAuth MCP.

notRecommendedOrUnverified.name: googleworkspace/developer-mcp
notRecommendedOrUnverified.reason: Archived developer-documentation server, not Gmail/Drive/Calendar data access; do not confuse it with Workspace remote MCP or the community Workspace bridge.

notRecommendedOrUnverified.name: googleworkspace/cli as MCP
notRecommendedOrUnverified.reason: Current primary README describes a CLI/Agent Skills, not an MCP server. Could support an Ompra skill via CLI, but does not establish an MCP endpoint; project itself says it is not an officially supported Google product.

notRecommendedOrUnverified.name: Shopify Admin unrestricted connector
notRecommendedOrUnverified.reason: Official dev and storefront MCP capabilities do not verify general merchant-admin access. Community bridges exist, but were not audited sufficiently to recommend as first-party equivalents.

notRecommendedOrUnverified.name: Individual Outlook and Teams universal OAuth MCP
notRecommendedOrUnverified.reason: Official enterprise Work IQ exists; general personal-account Ompra compatibility is unverified. Do not present OpenAI's built-in Outlook/Teams connectors as portable OMP packages.

displayRecommendations.googleCardRule: Separate product cards may all point to one explicitly community-maintained Workspace bridge; explain shared installation/auth and selected service scopes rather than installing seven independent runtime copies.
displayRecommendations.evidenceLabel: Documentation verified 2026-10-10; not authenticated execution-tested and not a security certification.
displayRecommendations.actionRule: A setup-guide card must not display Installed/Connected solely because its text skill was installed. Connection success requires actual client auth and tools/list verification. Unsupported OAuth paths need an honest setup-required state.
